# Kaya Global Agency

> U.S.-based studio (a brand of KAYA GLOBAL TRANSPORTATION LLC, Tustin, CA) that builds mobile-first websites and AI/automation systems for small local businesses: auto repair, salons, towing, home services and more. Clients in the U.S. and abroad; service in English, Spanish and Turkish.

## What we do
- Custom small-business websites, built for Google and phones. Free working preview before any payment.
- Automation: missed-call text-back, SMS reminders, lead follow-up, Google review requests, online booking.
- AI chat assistant that answers customers and books appointments 24/7.
- Google Business Profile setup and management.

## Pricing (USD)
- Website setup: $450 one-time ($299 founding price for the first 5 clients).
- Monthly care: Basic $39, Growth $69, Pro $129. No contracts, cancel with 30 days notice. Client owns domain and content.
- Add-ons: AI chat assistant $49/mo, review automation $29/mo, missed-call text-back + SMS reminders $29/mo, online booking $99.
